text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the break, I exchanged greetings 
with Winning Ticket in the central plaza, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
choice_data_list:
You look sleepy, what were you doing 
yesterday?

You look sleepy, what were you doing 
yesterday?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see, I wanted to spend my day 
off to the fullest. There were sooooo many 
things I wanted to do, so—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
We spent the whole day doing 
eee-ve-ry-thing! Manga, movies, food, and 
cycling!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: It was so much fun. But... after that—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, it was already 
morning... Huaaaahhh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Winning Ticket went all out even 
on her day off, and ended up 
sleep-deprived...
